title: Search aliases for renamed spare parts
passage:
MERRICK SERVICE | Parts search change note

Some replacement handles have new product names. The printed service list will show only the new names. Keep each old name as a search alias in the staff tool so a technician reading an old repair note can still find the right replacement. An alias is not printed on a packing ticket and cannot be used as the name on an invoice.

If the same old name points to two current parts, the search tool must show both records. Add the handle length to each result instead of choosing one as the default. The length lets technicians distinguish them without asking the warehouse to guess from the name.

On Friday, the help desk will send a list of searches that found nothing. Correct old names that were entered incorrectly as aliases. If an old name is spelled correctly but belongs to a part we no longer carry, leave the alias out and add the name to the discontinued-parts note. A search with no result is better than sending a technician to an unrelated part.
passageZh:
梅里克維修部｜備品搜尋變更說明

有些替換用把手已改用新的產品名稱。印刷版維修清單只會列新名稱。請在員工工具中保留每個舊名稱作為搜尋別名，讓技術員查閱舊維修紀錄時仍能找到正確的替換品。別名不印在裝箱單上，也不能當作發票上的品名。

若同一個舊名稱對應兩種現行零件，搜尋工具必須顯示兩筆資料。請在各筆結果上加註把手長度，不要選其中一筆當預設結果。長度有助技術員辨別，不必請倉庫只憑名稱猜測。

星期五，服務台會送來一份找不到結果的搜尋清單。若有別名輸入錯誤，請把舊名稱更正。如果舊名稱拼寫正確，但對應的零件已不再供應，就不要把它列為別名，而應加到停供零件備註。搜尋沒有結果，也比把技術員導向無關零件好。
